{
  "schema_version": "structured_v1_icaira",
  "criterion_comparisons": [
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C2",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C2",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Released hours drive the business case; recurring cost matters but benefit determines whether the investment pays back."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Limited implementation capacity makes integration effort a real constraint; throughput headroom is adequate across candidates."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Probability-weighted compliance loss is material and governance-critical; it can erase productivity gains and trigger audit exposure."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual cash outlay hits budget cycles directly; onboarding hours are a one-time absorbable cost."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Compliance loss threatens balance sheet and reputation; throughput is a technical sufficiency check."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Sustained annual benefit outweighs a one-off integration effort, provided delivery capacity remains feasible."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Total cost visibility anchors the funding decision; expected loss is important but estimated and insurable."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C5_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C5",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C5",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Throughput supports organization-wide scalability; onboarding time is a smaller, temporary adoption cost."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Recurring compliance exposure outweighs a bounded, one-time engineering effort."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual hours released are the measurable outcome; training time is a modest deduction from it."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Recurring spend competes with other capital demands; throughput only needs to meet the latency ceiling."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Audit and data-exposure losses carry governance consequences far beyond user training hours."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Productivity benefit is the value the board will measure; capacity is an enabler, not the outcome."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Ongoing annual cost affects cash flow every year; integration effort is a single implementation charge."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Scarce engineering capacity gates time-to-value; onboarding is distributed and easier to absorb."
    }
  ],
  "declared_priority_order": ["C1", "C2", "C4"]
}
